title: My House
text:
This is my house. It is small and blue. There is a big kitchen and a living room. The kitchen has a table and four chairs.

My bedroom is upstairs. There is a bed, a desk, and a big window. The bed is next to the window. I like my room very much.

questions.text: How does the writer feel about their room?
options: The writer feels happy about it
The writer wants to move out
The writer does not like it
The writer feels afraid of it

questions.text: Who probably lives in this house?

vocabulary.definition: a room where you cook food
an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light
on a higher floor of a building

paragraph_translations: To jest mój dom. Jest mały i niebieski. Jest duża kuchnia i salon. W kuchni jest stół i cztery krzesła.
Moja sypialnia jest na górze. Jest tam łóżko, biurko i duże okno. Łóżko jest obok okna. Bardzo lubię mój pokój.
